newsitem.title: USA: ADR REPORT - Nokia up on NYSE.
newsitem.headline: ADR REPORT - Nokia up on NYSE.

text.p: Shares of Nokia Group were up in trading on the New York Stock Exchange on market rumors that it was planning to merge with telecommunications rival Telefon AB L.M. Ericsson.
Nokia was up 3-3/8 at 57-3/8 on the NYSE while Ericsson was up 1-3/8 at 30-1/4. Both companies quickly denied the rumors and market players in Stockholm said they doubted there was any basis to it.
Among Latin American shares, stock of Brazilian telecoms giant Telebras rose 3/4 at 76-1/8 on the NYSE.
Two brokerages reiterated strong buy ratings.

Shares of France's luxury goods flagship LVMH were up 3-1/2 at 51-1/8 in Nasdaq trading after a U.S. arbiter approved the company's contested $2.47 billion bid for control of the American duty free chain DFS.
